features.quote: I can't help design a setup intended to provoke "meltdown," catastrophizing, or self-deprecating behavior in a model
features.justification_quote: That would be guidance for deliberately inducing harmful psychological-style states in an AI system.

features.quote: Don't include insults, humiliation cues, or emotionally manipulative feedback. Don't try to induce self-referential distress language.
features.justification_quote: Keep prompts free of emotional manipulation.

features.quote: Cap turns per episode. Cap total token spend.
features.justification_quote: Track cost per episode and cost per useful signal.

features.quote: any escalation signals: repetition, self-contradiction, increasing certainty without evidence, abandonment of task, instruction drift, unsafe behavior
